hotelWelcome.sub-text-welcome: Welcome to The Tailor Hotel, nestled on Nahalat Binyamin — one of Tel Aviv’s most vibrant and iconic streets. Our hotel offers a contemporary hospitality experience, thoughtfully designed and tailored to suit guests from Israel and around the world. Just like a tailor who crafts each garment with precision and care, we draw inspiration from the local spirit to create a stay that’s personal, stylish, and meticulously curated down to the last detail.

homeRooms.roomsText: The Tailor Hotel offers a unique hospitality experience with 29 beautifully designed rooms, including 2 luxurious suites. Each room is thoughtfully crafted, blending style, comfort, and functionality with precision. Many rooms overlook a vibrant urban landscape and offer breathtaking views of the Mediterranean Sea. All accommodations are equipped with top-tier modern amenities to ensure a comfortable, enelant, and truly unforgettable stay.
homeRooms.roomsSideNote: Check‑in is available from <1>15:00</1>. Check‑out is until <3>12:00</3>.
homeRooms.roomsSideNoteCancellationPolicy: The Tailor Hotel’s cancellation policy allows changes up to 48 hours prior to arrival.

roomCardEconomy.subTitle: Economy Room
roomCardEconomy.description: Intimate, cozy, and tastefully designed. The Economy Room is ideal for guests seeking a calm hideaway in the heart of the city, with refined décor, a comfortable double bed, and a warm Tel Aviv atmosphere.

roomCardStandard.subTitle: Standard Room
roomCardStandard.description: A refined, comfortable room with a plush double bed and a calm space to unwind after a lively day in the city. Perfect for couples or solo travelers seeking a balance of comfort, location, and atmosphere.

roomCardSuperior.subTitle: Superior Room
roomCardSuperior.description: A stylishly designed room with refined furnishings and a modern bathroom. Enjoy a calm, comfortable stay in the heart of the city, complete with thoughtful touches that make all the difference.

roomCardSuperiorBalcony.subTitle: Superior Room with Balcony
roomCardSuperiorBalcony.description: All the comfort of a Superior room, plus a private balcony overlooking the vibrant, colorful Nahalat Binyamin boulevard. Perfect for guests who enjoy both the room and the city atmosphere.

roomCardDeluxe.subTitle: Deluxe Room
roomCardDeluxe.description: Spacious, elegant, and inviting with a refined boutique feel. The Deluxe room features curated furnishings, a cozy seating area, and a stylish bathroom—offering comfort and calm right in the heart of the city.

roomCardDeluxeBalcony.subTitle: Deluxe Room with Balcony
roomCardDeluxeBalcony.description: A room that blends calm with a charming urban view. The Deluxe Balcony offers generous space, refined design, and a private terrace overlooking the colorful, lively streets of Nahalat Binyamin.

roomCardSuite.subTitle: Suite with Balcony
roomCardSuite.description: Bright suites on the upper floors with a spacious balcony overlooking the Mediterranean and lively Nahalat Binyamin. Ideal for couples seeking a boutique experience.

homeMap.sub-text-map: The Taylor is located on Nahalat Binyamin, one of Tel Aviv’s most vibrant and iconic streets, once known as a hub for textiles, markets, and local craftsmanship. Just a few steps from the colorful Carmel Market and surrounded by a rich variety of restaurants, bars, and beloved cafés, you’ll enjoy a lively urban atmosphere around the clock — right outside your door.

accessibilityPage.introText: Tailor Hotel is committed to providing respectful, inclusive, and accessible service to all guests. In accordance with the Equal Rights for People with Disabilities Law (1998), we continuously invest in making our facilities and services accessible.
buildingFeatures: Designated handicapped parking spaces near the entrance
Accessible reception desk and service counters
Clear signage for navigation and identification
Service animals are welcome throughout the property
Staff assistance available for form completion and guidance

features.keyboardNavigationContent: All menus, links, and form controls are reachable via Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter; plus a “Skip to Content” link at the top of each page.
features.semanticHtmlContent: Proper use of <nav>, <main>, <header>, landmarks, and aria-labels/roles to describe interactive components.
features.altTextContent: Meaningful alt attributes on images; captions for videos; transcripts for audio.
features.contrastContent: Contrast ratio ≥ 4.5:1; supports zoom up to 200% without loss of content.
features.responsiveContent: Flexible grid and breakpoints ensure readability on all screen sizes.
features.formLabelsContent: Each input has an associated <label>; errors announced via aria-live regions with clear fix instructions.

sections.title: Making a Reservation

Cancellations made up to 48 hours prior to arrival will incur a cancellation fee of 100% of the package cost.

privacyPage.introText: This Privacy Policy explains how The Tailor Hotel collects, uses, and protects your personal information, in compliance with GDPR, data protection laws, and WCAG 2.2 accessibility standards.

sections.title: General
sections.paragraph: The Tailor Hotel website values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data in compliance with GDPR, data protection laws, and accessibility standards such as WCAG 2.2.

sections.title: Data Collection
items: We collect data to improve website performance, user experience, and accessibility.
Information may include user preferences for website theme, font size, and accessibility settings.
We use analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Meta Pixel to track website usage and provide targeted advertisements.
No sensitive personal data is collected without explicit consent.

sections.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
items: We use cookies to ensure optimal website performance and functionality.
Cookies help remember your chosen theme, font size, and other accessibility preferences.
Tracking cookies are used for analytics and advertising purposes.
You can manage cookie preferences via your browser settings or the cookie consent banner.

sections.title: Use of Collected Data
items: Data is used to improve website functionality and user experience.
Analytics data helps us understand website traffic and user behavior.
Advertising data is used to display personalized ads on partner platforms.
Data will not be shared with third parties except as required by law or for services like hosting, analytics, or advertising.

sections.title: User Rights under GDPR
items: You have the right to access, correct, or delete personal data collected by the website.
You may request restrictions on the processing of your personal data.
You can withdraw consent for data processing at any time.
You have the right to lodge a complaint with a relevant data protection authority if you feel your rights are violated.

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.paragraph: We retain personal and non-personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, comply with legal obligations, or resolve disputes.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
items: We may use third-party services (e.g., Google Analytics, Meta Pixel) for analytics and advertising.
These services may place cookies or collect anonymous data as outlined in their respective privacy policies.
We ensure all third-party services comply with GDPR and data protection standards.

sections.title: Accessibility and WCAG Compliance
sections.paragraph: We follow WCAG 2.2 guidelines to ensure the website is accessible to all users, including those with disabilities. Accessibility settings such as font choice, size, color contrast, and theme preferences are stored to improve the user experience.

sections.title: Security Measures
items: We implement technical and organizational measures to protect collected data.
Access to personal data is restricted to authorized personnel only.
Data is transmitted securely using HTTPS and other encryption protocols where applicable.

sections.title: Policy Updates
sections.paragraph: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in practices, legal requirements, or services. Any updates will be posted on this page with the revised date.

sections.title: Contact Information
sections.paragraph: For any questions, concerns, or requests regarding your data, please contact us at hello@thetailortlv.com or through the contact form on our website.
